faq.a1: USebenza liqonga lesizwe letalente lase-South Africa. Abafuni bomsebenzi benza iprofayile kanye kwaye banokufunyanwa ngabaqeshi abaqinisekisiweyo kuwo onke amaphondo asi-9. Abaqeshi bakhangela iiprofayile eziphilayo, ezilinganiswa ngokutsha, ngomsebenzi, ngephondo nangezakhono. Iqhutywa yi-Yetotec (Pty) Ltd kwaye yakhiwe nge-POPIA kuqala.
faq.a2: Ewe. Ukwenza iprofayile, ukufunyanwa, ukwamkela izimemo nokwamkela umsebenzi kusimahla kubafuni bomsebenzi. USebenza asiyoarhente yengqesho. Asize sithathe mali kumvuzo wakho.
faq.a3: Abaqeshi abaqinisekisiweyo bakhangela ngomsebenzi, ngephondo nangezakhono. Iprofayile yakho yoluntu ibonisa igama elifihliweyo kwaye ayize ibonise iinkcukacha zakho zoqhagamshelwano, inombolo yesazisi okanye amaxwebhu. Umqeshi ufikelela kuwe kuphela ngeqonga, ngemvume yakho, kwaye konke ukuvezwa koqhagamshelwano kurekhodwa kwilog yophicotho onokuyijonga.
faq.q4: Ingaba ndidinga imatriki okanye isidanga ukuze ndijoyine?
faq.a4: Hayi. USebenza ungowawo onke amanqanaba ezakhono: ukusuka kubasebenzi jikelele, iingcali zemisebenzi yezandla nakubaqhubi ukuya kubaphumeleleyo nakwiingcali. Abafundi bangoku banokubhalisa iprofayile yomfundi nomhla wokugqiba olindelekileyo. Okubalulekileyo yiprofayile enyanisekileyo, hayi isiqinisekiso esithile.
faq.a5: USebenza wakhiwe ngokujikeleze i-POPIA, umthetho wase-South Africa wokhuselo lwedatha. Unika imvume ethile ngendlela nganye ulwazi lwakho olusetyenziswa ngayo, kwaye unganqumamisa ukubonakala kwakho okanye urhoxise imvume nanini na. Amacandelo abuthathaka ayabethelwa, amaphepha oluntu ayafihlwa, kwaye konke ukufikelela kulwazi lwakho kuyarekhodwa.
faq.a6: Ibheji yokuqinisekisa ithetha ukuba iqonga liqinisekise into ngokwenene, umzekelo umqeshi eqinisekisa irekhodi lomsebenzi. Yonke iprofayile iqala ithi “ayiqinisekiswanga” kwaye sikutsho oko ngokunyaniseka; iibheji azithengwa kwaye azicingelwa. Amanani abala ukuqeshwa kuphela xa kuqinisekisiwe ngeqonga.

finalCta.lead: Nokuba ufuna umsebenzi okanye ufuna abantu, eyona ndlela ikhawulezayo eya kwisiphumo sokwenene, esiqinisekisiweyo, sangoku lukhangelo olunye nje.

step1.heading: Sixelele ukuba ungubani
step1.subhead: Ezi ziseko kuphela. Siza kongeza okunye kwiprofayile yakho emva kwemvume.
step1.citizenHelp: Isetyenziselwa kuphela amanani ezengqesho nokuqaqanjiswa kwabemi base-South Africa kukhangelo lwabaqeshi. Ayize ichaphazele ukuba ungamsebenzisa na uSebenza okanye ufunyanwe. Wonke umntu udityaniswa ngendawo nangesakhono.
step1.nationalityHelp: Iboniswa kwiprofayile yakho nakwiziphumo zokhangelo ukuze abaqeshi bazi apho uvela khona. USebenza udibanisa ngendawo nangesakhono. Apho uvela khona akuze kube ngumqobo.

step3.heading: Amacandelo okuqala eprofayile yakho

Siza kuthatha iinkcukacha zezifundo zakho ukuze uSebenza akwazi ukukucebisa ngezifundo ezikhethwayo, ii-internship neenkqubo zabaphumeleleyo, hayi ukuqeshwa okupheleleyo kuphela.

auditLog.noEvents: Akukho kufikelela kwe-PII okwangoku kule seshoni. Tyelela ku-/search okanye uvule iprofayile uze ulayishe kwakhona. Zonke iziganeko ziza kuvela apha.

meta.title: Indlela uSebenza asebenza ngayo
meta.description: USebenza luluhlu lukazwelonke lwetalente lwase-South Africa olwakhiwe nge-POPIA kuqala. Abafuni bomsebenzi benza iprofayile enye yasimahla bafunyanwe; abaqeshi bakhangela italente ephilayo eqinisekiswe ngokunyaniseka; ukuqeshwa okuqinisekisiweyo kuba lulwazi lokwenene lwemarike yezengqesho.

hero.lead: USebenza luluhlu lukazwelonke lwetalente olwakhiwe nge-POPIA kuqala. Abafuni bomsebenzi benza iprofayile enye yasimahla bafunyanwe. Abaqeshi bakhangela italente ephilayo, elinganiswa ngokutsha, eqinisekiswe ngokunyaniseka. Ukuqeshwa okulandelayo kuba lulwazi lokwenene lwemarike yezengqesho, hayi uqikelelo.
hero.microcopy: Kusimahla kubafuni bomsebenzi, rhoqo. Isebenza kuyo nayiphi na ifowuni, ngesiNgesi, ngesiZulu, ngesiXhosa nangesiBhulu.

problem.heading: Ukuqesha e-South Africa kusebenza ngengxolo
problem.item1: Ii-CV ezilikhulu kwiqela le-WhatsApp, kungekho ndlela yokwazi ukuba ngubani ongowokwenene.
problem.item2: Oovimba apho isiqingatha sabantu “abafumanekayo” safumana umsebenzi kwiinyanga ezidlulileyo.
problem.item3: Iibheji ezithi kuqinisekisiwe kanti akukho mntu uqinisekise nto.
problem.item4: Abafuni bomsebenzi behlawula ukuze babonwe, okanye belahlekelwa yimali ngabaqeshi bobuxoki.
problem.closeA: I-South Africa awunakunqongophala kwetalente. Unokunqongophala kophawu oluthembekileyo.

who.heading: Uluhlu olunye, amacala amathathu
who.seekersBody: Yenza iprofayile enye: izakhono zakho, amava, ukufumaneka, nalapho ukhoyo. Funyanwa ngabaqeshi abaqinisekisiweyo, menywe kwizikhundla zokwenene ezinamagama, faka isicelo ngamakhonkco oluntu ezithuba, kwaye ulawule lonke ulwazi lwakho phantsi kwe-POPIA. Ukusuka kubasebenzi jikelele neengcali zemisebenzi yezandla ukuya kubaphumeleleyo nakwiingcali. Nabafundi ngokunjalo.
who.employersBody: Khangela ngesakhono, ngendawo nangokufumaneka, hayi ngethamsanqa. Bona iimeko zokuqinisekiswa ezinyanisekileyo nokuba iprofayile nganye intsha kangakanani. Lawula izithuba: dibanisa abantu ngokubuyela umva, bameme kwizikhundla ezinamagama, wabelane ngekhonkco loluntu lokufaka isicelo ku-WhatsApp, kwaye urekhode ukuqeshwa xa kusenzeka.
who.governmentBody: Iportali yamanani efundwa kuphela, enomda wobumfihlo: apho imfuno ikhona, apho ukufumaneka kukhona, kutheni izikhundla zingazaliswa, kutheni abafundi bebambeka, nokuba ikharityhulam ihambelana njani nemarike. Onke amanani angu-k-anonymised kwaye adityanisiwe. Akuze kube ngumntu obonakalayo.

difference.heading: Ukunyaniseka luphawu
difference.b1: Ibheji ithi iqinisekisiwe kuphela xa kukho into eqinisekiswe ngokwenene. Asize sihombise idatha ezixelwe nguwe.
difference.b2: Yonke imeko yengqesho inomhla wokuqinisekiswa. Iiprofayile ezindala zihla kuluhlu ngokunyaniseka endaweni yokuchitha iminxeba yakho.
difference.b3: Amanani ethu okubekwa arekhodwa ngeqonga, akaze azixelwe kwispredishithi.
difference.b4: Akukho zinombolo zesazisi, akukho maxwebhu, akukho nkcukacha zoqhagamshelwano kukhangelo. Uqhagamshelwano luvezwa kuphela kubaqeshi abaqinisekisiweyo, ngemvume, kwaye konke ukuvezwa kurekhodwa apho umfuni womsebenzi anokukubona khona.
difference.b5: Abantu badityaniswa ngalapho bekhoyo nangoko banokukwenza. Ubuzwe buyaboniswa, abuze bube lisango.

how.heading: Iluphu enye, ukusuka kwiprofayile ukuya kumgaqo-nkqubo
how.lead: Ukuqesha yimveliso. Amanani aphuma kuko ngokunyaniseka.
how.s1b: Izakhono, amava, ukufumaneka, indawo. Simahla, ngeelwimi ezine, kuyo nayiphi na ifowuni.
how.s2b: Izihluzi eziphilayo ngesakhono, ngephondo nangokufumaneka, okanye udibaniso olubuyela umva kwisithuba esithile.
how.s3b: Umqeshi umema umfuni womsebenzi kwisikhundla esinegama, okanye abelane ngekhonkco loluntu le-Self Apply lesithuba naphi na, kubandakanya i-WhatsApp, abafuni bomsebenzi bangene ngokwabo.
how.s4b: Abaqeshi abaqinisekisiweyo kuphela. Kuphicothwa ngalo lonke ixesha. Umfuni womsebenzi uyabona ukuba ngubani omfikeleleyo.
how.s5b: Kurekhodwa ngeqonga, ngoko kubalwa kanye kwaye kubalwa ngenyaniso.
how.s6b: Ukuqeshwa okuqinisekisiweyo kudityaniswa kumanani angu-k-anonymised: imfuno, ukufumaneka, ukunqongophala, iziphumo. Kuphila, hayi okonyaka ophelileyo.

growth.heading: Nakulowo ufuna umsebenzi ongekafunyanwa
growth.lead: I-Sebenza ayikudwelisi nje. Iyakukhulisa, ngomjikelo omnye onyanisekileyo.
growth.g1t: Ikhampasi yakho yomsebenzi ifunda imfuno yokwenene.
growth.g1b: Ijonga oko abaqeshi abakufuphi nawe abakukhangelayo nabaqesha ngako ngenene, ikuthelekise nezakhono zakho, ize ichaze umsantsa ofanele uvalwe kuqala.
growth.g2b: Iindlela zase-South Africa zasimahla nezingabizi kakhulu, ii-learnership ze-SETA, iinkqubo zase-TVET, izifundo ezaziwayo ze-online, ezilungelelaniswe naloo msantsa kanye.
growth.g3b: Uthi ugqiba nje, sibalwe. Akukho zatifikethi zilayishwayo; iprofayile yakho iyakhula nje.
growth.g4b: Iziphumo zokukhangela zithanda izakhono abaqeshi abazifunayo. Ukufunda into elungileyo kukunyusa, ikhampasi ide ikubonise utsibo olulindelekileyo phambi kokuba uqale.
growth.g5b: Yiloo nto kanye injongo: uyafumaneka ngomsebenzi onokuwenza ngenene. Kwaye xa kusiba kukuqeshwa, kuqinisekiswa kwiqonga, kubalwe ngokunyaniseka.

proof.heading: Sikhetha ukukubonisa amanani aphilayo
proof.lead: La manani avela ngqo kuluhlu ngomzuzu ovula ngawo eli phepha. Ngamanani afanayo needeshbhodi zethu ezisebenza ngawo. Alinganiswa ngokutsha, akaze akhukhunyaliswe.
proof.honest: USebenza usemtsha kwaye asiyi kuzenza ngathi akunjalo. Asiqambi zincomo zeenkwenkwezi ezintlanu: njengoko abantu bokwenene nabaqeshi besitsho izinto zokwenene, amazwi abo avela apha namagama abo, kwaye ngemvume yabo kuphela.
proof.promise1: Kusimahla kubafuni bomsebenzi. Akukho ntlawulo, nanini, kwaye akukho kuhlawula ukuze unyuke.
proof.promise2: I-POPIA kuqala ukususela kumgca wokuqala wekhowudi: imvume eyahlukanisiweyo, ubethelo lwamacandelo, ilog yophicotho esisigxina, ukukhupha nokucima kwakhelwe ngaphakathi.
proof.promise3: Iibheji ezinyanisekileyo, ukutsha okunyanisekileyo, amanani okubekwa anyanisekileyo. Uluhlu lukhetha ukubonakala luncinci kunokuxoka.
proof.promise4: Yakhelwe i-South Africa wokwenene: i-Android esezantsi ku-3G sisixhobo sethu sesalathiso, iilwimi ezine zokuqalisa, iyafakelwa njengosetyenziso.

why.heading: Kutheni uSebenza, hayi enye ibhodi yemisebenzi
why.b1: Iibhodi zemisebenzi zidwelisa izibhengezo. USebenza ugcina uluhlu oluphilayo, olulinganiswa ngokutsha lwabantu, kwaye izikhundla ziza kubo.
why.b2: Iimeko zokuqinisekiswa, amasango emvume, ukuvezwa okuphicothwayo nokufihlwa kunyanzeliswa ngekhowudi, kuko konke ukufundwa.
why.b3: Kuba ukuqeshwa kuqinisekiswa kwiqonga, umfanekiso odityanisiweyo ngowokwenene: iimpawu zokunqongophala eziphilayo, iziphumo zokubekwa, ikharityhulam ethelekiswa nemfuno. Konke ku-k-anonymised.
why.b4: Abaqeshi batsala ngokhangelo nangezimemo; abafuni bomsebenzi bangena ngamakhonkco oluntu e-Self Apply abelwana naphi na. Umbhobho omnye, ophawulwe ngokunyaniseka.
why.b5: Abafuni bomsebenzi banganqumamisa ukubonakala, bavale umqeshi, bakhuphe konke, okanye bazicime. Imvume yeyenjongo nganye, ayize ibe yibhokisi enye evumela konke.

pricing.heading: Kusimahla kubafuni bomsebenzi. Kulula kubo bonke abanye.
pricing.lead: Uluhlu lukazwelonke lusebenza kuphela xa wonke umntu wase-South Africa enokukwazi ukuba kulo, ngoko icala lomfuni womsebenzi lisimahla, ngokusisigxina. Ubudlelwane babaqeshi norhulumente buxatyiswa ngokobungakanani beqela neengxelo abazidingayo.

finalCta.heading: Zibonele uluhlu ngokwakho.
finalCta.lead: Lukhangele njengondwendwe, joyina njengomfuni womsebenzi, okanye usibhalele sikuhambise kumacala abaqeshi nawamanani ngokwemeko yakho. Akukho ngcinezelo, akukho lwimi lunzima.

pushOptIn.title: Yaziswa efowunini yakho
pushOptIn.offBody: Xa umqeshi ekumemela kwindima, ifowuni yakho inokukuxelela kwangoko. Izimemo ziyaphelelwa, ngoko ukuva sele kusemva kunokukulahlekisela ithuba. Asifaki iinkcukacha zakho kwisaziso ngokwaso.
pushOptIn.onBody: Ivuliwe kule divayisi{others, plural, =0 {} one { nakwenye enye} other { nakwezinye ezingu-#}}. Ungayivala apha nanini na, kwaye ukhethe ukuba zeziphi izaziso ezifikelela efowunini yakho kwiimfuno zakho.
pushOptIn.blockedBody: Isikhangeli sakho sivala izaziso zeSebenza. Asikwazi ukubuza kwakhona sisuka apha: zivule kwiisetingi zesikhangeli sakho zale sayithi, uze uphinde ulayishe eli phepha.
pushOptIn.installBody: Kwi-iPhone ne-iPad, izaziso zisebenza kuphela xa iSebenza yongezwe kwiscreen sakho sasekhaya. Cofa u-Share, uze u-Add to Home Screen, vula iSebenza ukusuka apho, kwaye olu khetho luya kuvela.
pushOptIn.errRegister: Le divayisi ayikwazanga ukubhaliswa. Nceda uzame kwakhona.

title.label: Isihloko sendima
title.hint: Ilebhile iqela lakho eliyibonayo kuluhlu lwezithuba.

description.label: Inkcazo
description.placeholder: Yintoni eyenziwa yile ndima, inika ingxelo kubani, kwaye impumelelo ijongeka njani kwiintsuku ezingama-90 zokuqala. Yeyangaphakathi kuphela, akukho mfuni-msebenzi uyibonayo.

match.heading: Iimfuno zokuhambelana
match.sub: Isetyenziselwa ukunciphisa uluhlu lwabafaki-zicelo kwiskrini esithi “Fumana abafanelekileyo”. Shiya nayiphi na indawo ingenanto ukuba ayilofuneko: umhambelanisi uya kuyityeshela loo nto ngokupheleleyo.

workMode.sub: Khetha konke okufanelekileyo. Ukungakhethi nto = indima yamkela nayiphi na indlela yokusebenza okanye uhlobo lwengqesho.

season.heading: Ithuba lexesha lonyaka
season.sub: Akunyanzelekanga. Khetha inyanga (nonyaka, ukuba uyafuna) kuwo omabini amanqaku. Unyaka awunyanzelekanga kodwa uyacetyiswa kumathuba asehlotyeni adlula kuDisemba. Shiya omabini engenanto ukuba uthi “umsebenzi wexesha elithile, ixesha liya kuqinisekiswa”.

minYears.label: Iminyaka esincinci yamava
minYears.hint: Shiya kungenanto ukuba oku akulofuneko. Abafuni-msebenzi abangakhange bachaze inani abayi kudlula xa sele umisele umda.

minNqf.label: Inqanaba elisezantsi le-NQF
minNqf.hint: Shiya kungenanto ukuba oku akulofuneko (uninzi lwemisebenzi yezandla, ukubuka iindwendwe, umsebenzi wexeshana nokuthengisa akuyi kufuna eli).

salary.heading: Yimfihlo kumbutho wakho
salary.sub: Ibhendi yomvuzo ihlala ngaphakathi kwindawo yakho yokusebenza. Ayikhe iboniswe kuso nasiphi na isithuba esibonwa ngumfuni-msebenzi, ayikho kukhangelo, kwaye ayikho kwiprofayile yoluntu.
salary.label: Ibhendi yomvuzo

expiry.heading: Ukuphelelwa lixesha kwesimemo
expiry.sub: Ixesha isimemo esihlala sivuliwe ngalo ukuba umfuni-msebenzi akaphendulanga. Xa siphelelwa lixesha, omabini amacala afumana isaziso. Shiya kungenanto (okanye u-0) ukugcina izimemo zivuliwe ngonaphakade.
expiry.label: Iintsuku kude kuphelelwe isimemo
expiry.hint: Iintsuku ezili-14 zezona ziqhelekileyo; u-0 okanye okungenanto = akuphelelwa.

positions.label: Izikhundla ezivulekileyo
positions.hint: Bangaphi abantu ocwangcisa ukubaqesha kwesi sithuba. Shiya kungenanto ukuba akukho nani limiselweyo; iphepha lokuhambelanisa liya kubala izimemo nje.

nudge.label: Thumela isikhumbuzo esithambileyo emva kweentsuku ezisi-7
nudge.sub: Isikhumbuzo esinye, kubafuni-msebenzi abangekaphenduli kuphela. Sinomda wesikhumbuzo esinye kwisimemo ngasinye: ukuphinda ukhumbuze kukuhlukumeza.

selfApply.label: Vumela abafuni-msebenzi bafake isicelo ngekhonkco loluntu
selfApply.sub: Yenza iphepha elinokwabelwana ngalo elinendima, izakhono nenkcazo (alinabhendi yomvuzo kubatyeleli, alinalo uluhlu lwakho). Abafaki-zicelo bafika kuluhlu lwesi sithuba njengabafaki-zicelo abamkelweyo benophawu oluthi “Uzifakele isicelo”. Uyabahlola kwaye ubakhethe njengabafuni-msebenzi abamenyiweyo. Susa uphawu nanini na ukuvala ikhonkco.

list.title: Izithuba
list.subtitle: Yimfihlo kumbutho wakho. Izithuba ziinkcazelo zokuhambelanisa okubuyisiweyo: mema abantu abathile, ufumane ukwamkela okanye ukukhaba kwabo nesizathu, uze ubhale ukubekwa xa sele izalisiwe. Ayize ibe sisibhengezo soluntu.
list.viewerNote: Indima yakho kwindawo yokusebenza nguMboneleli, ngoko uluhlu lwezithuba lufundwa kuphela kuwe. Cela uMnini okanye uMqeshi ukuba enze okanye ahlele izithuba.

filled.heading: Uqeshe bani ku-“{vacancyTitle}”?
filled.lead: Ukubhala uqesho ngoku kugcina idatha yokubekwa kazwelonke inyanisekile, kwaye abafuni-msebenzi abangakhethwanga bafumana umqondiso wokukhula onyanisekileyo. Kuvunyelwe uqesho oluninzi.
filled.acceptedEmpty: Abekho abamkele izimemo kwesi sithuba okwangoku. Sebenzisa ukhangelo olungezantsi ukubhala uqesho oluvela ngaphandle koluhlu lwezimemo.
filled.noticeLine: Isaziso: {months, plural, one {inyanga e-1} other {iinyanga ezingu-#}}
filled.outsideNote: Kuphelele kubafaki-zicelo bephondo lesi sithuba. Uqesho lwangaphandle koluhlu lugqitywa ngohlelo lwedosiye emva kokuthumela; le modali iyalulinda.
filled.shortNote: Oko kushiyeka ngabangu-{short} kwabangu-{positions} obamiseleyo. Ukuphawula oku njengokuzalisiweyo kuvala isithuba nangona kunjalo, nto leyo ilungileyo ukuba ugcwalise abanye kwenye indawo. Ukuba usakhangela, vala oku uze umeme abanye abantu.
filled.skipConfirm: Ukutsiba kuya kuphawula isithuba njengesizalisiweyo ngaphandle kokubhala ukuba uqeshe bani. Izibalo zeSebenza zisebenza ngcono xa sonke isithuba esizalisiweyo sinedatha yokubekwa. Uqinisekile?
filled.pickOneError: Khetha ubuncinane omnye oqeshiweyo, okanye usebenzise ikhonkco elithi Tsiba.
filled.submit: Phawula izalisiwe + bhala {count, plural, one {oqeshiweyo om-1} other {abaqeshiweyo abangu-#}}

placements.heading: Ukubekwa · {count} okubhaliweyo
placements.truthNote: Kuphela kukubekwa okuqinisekiswe ngumqeshi okubalwa kwizibalo zikazwelonke.
placements.filledPrompt: Esi sithuba siphawulwe njengesizalisiweyo: bhala ukubekwa okusivalileyo.
placements.filledPromptSub: Khetha umfaki-sicelo omqeshileyo ngezantsi. Idosiye livuleka nesi sithuba sele sinxulunyanisiwe, ucofo olunye ukuqinisekisa.
placements.acceptedWithNotice: Wamkela {months, plural, one {ngesaziso senyanga e-1} other {ngesaziso seenyanga ezingu-#}}
placements.outsideNote: Uqeshe umntu ongekhoyo kuluhlu lwabamkeleyo? Vula idosiye yakhe usebenzise u-Phawula njengoqeshiweyo; ukuqala kwesi sithuba kunxulumanisa ukubekwa kuso ngokuzenzekelayo.

detail.findSub: Kuhambelaniswe ngokubuyisiweyo nechibi letalente eliphilayo, kucwangcisiwe, kufihliwe, abemi baseMzantsi Afrika bagqanyisiwe kuqala.
detail.viewerNote: Indima yakho kwindawo yokusebenza nguMboneleli, ngoko iinkcukacha zesithuba zifundwa kuphela kuwe. Cela uMnini okanye uMqeshi ukuba enze utshintsho.
detail.footer: U-Fumana abafanelekileyo ucwangcisa abafaki-zicelo ngokwesi sithuba, u-Mema ucela abo ubakhethayo, kwaye impendulo yabo, kunye nesizathu ukuba basinika, ibuyela apha kumgca.
detail.expiryDays: {days, plural, one {usuku olu-1} other {iintsuku ezingu-#}} emva kokuthunyelwa kwesimemo ngasinye

selfApplyPanel.live: Nabani na onale khonkco ubona indima kwaye angafaka isicelo. Abafaki-zicelo bafika kulo mgca benophawu oluthi “Uzifakele isicelo”. Yabelana ngayo ku-WhatsApp, kwiipowusta, naphi na.
selfApplyPanel.paused: Isithuba asivulwanga, ngoko ikhonkco okwangoku libonisa oku “ayamkeli izicelo.” Liqala kwakhona ngokuzenzekelayo xa uvula isithuba kwakhona.

newPage.title: Isithuba esitsha
newPage.subtitle: Yimfihlo kumbutho wakho. Izithuba ziqala njengezoyilo, uzivule xa sele ukulungele ukumema abafaki-zicelo.
newPage.duplicateSubtitle: Izaliswe kwangaphambili ukusuka ku-“{source}”. Hlela nantoni na phambi kokugcina; oku kwenza uyilo olutsha, eyoqobo ihlala ingachukunyiswanga.
